intro: High Inquisitor Fairbanks was once a revered priest of the Knights of the Silver Hand and a trusted advisor to Highlord Alexandros Mograine. Once a prominent spiritual leader among Lordaeron's surviving defenders, his fate became tied to the dark descent of the Scarlet Crusade.

Before the fall of Lordaeron, Fairbanks was a respected holy man among the Knights of the Silver Hand. When Highlord Alexandros Mograine convened a fateful gathering at the Southshore inn, Fairbanks stood beside him, helping channel holy power into the enigmatic crystal that would eventually become the heart of the legendary Ashbringer. When Prince Arthas dissolved the paladin order, Fairbanks accompanied Mograine to Ironforge, standing witness as King Magni Bronzebeard forged the great blade to combat the Scourge.
